purpose: Keep objectives continuity-centric by surfacing known-good solutions, existing capabilities, superseded approaches, blocked-because reasons, and suggested next actions before rebuilding.

known_good_solutions.summary: MIM owns planning, governance, continuity, and operator-facing synthesis; TOD owns execution/runtime validation.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Route execution to TOD and keep MIM focused on objective state, escalation, and communication.

known_good_solutions.summary: Use runtime/shared file-backed artifacts for objective UI state when database objective queries are slow or unavailable.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Do not rebuild DB-backed objective pages until database latency is resolved; extend the file-backed continuity layer first.

known_good_solutions.summary: Use structured escalation packets with objective_id, problem_class, attempted_paths, canonical_solutions_checked, requested_action, expected_files, and validation_requirements.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Do not ask Codex with freeform blocker text when a structured packet can preserve lineage.

known_good_solutions.summary: Default replies should say what changed, what is blocked, what matters now, and the next action in under three sentences.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Suppress lifecycle/artifact leakage unless diagnostics are explicitly requested.

known_good_solutions.summary: Dave demonstrated known-good grip contact; yellow and green grip markers plus ToF/OAK-D evidence should be reused for pickup training.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Before retraining blindly, load MIM_ARM_KNOWN_GOOD_BLOCK_GRIP_DEMONSTRATION.latest.json and current arm camera/ToF evidence.

known_good_solutions.summary: Both ESP32 LoRa V3 boards were flashed/configured; phone pairing over Meshtastic was verified.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Do not repeat driver/flash discovery unless new boards are attached; start from ESP32_LORA_V3_MESHTASTIC_FLASH_STATUS.latest.json.

known_good_solutions.summary: Completion requires proof on the live operator-facing path, not only on helper scripts, remediation runners, or side paths.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Before marking an objective complete, validate the exact UI/API/scheduler/dispatcher path Dave will use or see. If only a side runner was validated, mark blocked_because=live_path_not_validated and create a follow-on objective.

known_good_solutions.summary: TOD implementation success requires a material diff, relevant file touch, behavior validation, live-path proof when applicable, and regression evidence.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: Reject wrapper-only implementation completions with blocked_because=material_implementation_not_proven. Treat TOD as orchestrator-supervising-Codex until it can synthesize and validate bounded patches with this evidence.

known_good_solutions.summary: A fresh wrapper around stale source evidence is not fresh execution. Track source age, evidence kind, trust rank, and lineage separately from latest-file timestamp.
known_good_solutions.reuse_guidance: If source evidence is old but a summary is new, mark stale_under_fresh_wrapper and require fresh live-path, validation, material diff, or direct runtime evidence before completion.

existing_capability_checks: Reuse candidate identified or ruled out

suggested_next_action_policy.format: next bounded task + confidence + reason + reuse candidates + escalation recommendation
prefer: ask operator only when boundary requires it
avoid: marking complete from helper/remediation runner success without live-path proof
marking implementation complete from wrapper-only status updates
treating a new summary timestamp as fresh execution evidence
